# A represented boundary and actual dependence

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Renewal over a region of conditions is renewal at the step where the region covers what the formation takes part in. Covering what it requires, with requirements not tightening, it keeps its own support yet can undermine another; omitting what it requires, its own draw can lose its own support.

`represented-boundary-against-dependence` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

A formation's event at t is within renewal over a region of conditions (Web.RenewingOver) when it is active and the step keeps every dependence on every condition of the region it takes part in. Renewal at the step is renewal over every region (Web.RenewingAt.over, Web.renewingAt_iff_over_all), and renewal over a region is renewal over every region inside it (Web.RenewingOver.narrow). Compared with the formation's actual relations: over a region covering every condition it takes part in, renewal over the region is renewal at the step (Web.RenewingOver.at); over a region covering every condition it requires, where its requirements do not tighten across the step, a formation renewing over the region is supported after the step (Web.RenewingOver.keeps_own), yet it can still undermine another: in Clearing the clearer renews over its resource, the one condition it requires, at every step, undermines at step one and is not within renewal there (Clearing.renewing_over_resource); over a region omitting a condition it requires, its own draw can undermine its own dependence: in Omitted a formation requires two conditions, renews over false at step zero with requirements not tightening, also requires true, which the region omits, and its draw on true undermines, so after the step it is not supported (Omitted.loses_own; balance, Acting, Taking and Dependent all hold). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Regions.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Regions.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- A region of conditions is a parameter of the statement; nothing here models how a center comes to represent it.
- keeps_own needs the region to cover every condition the formation requires at t and its requirements not to tighten across the step.
- The comparison is at one step; dependence over several steps (the sources feeding what is required) is not compared.
- Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren wrote that “recognizing the formation of the center is also with in the system, and the "boundary" is also with in the same cognitive system”, and of the self's “imagined boundary” that “it is also cognitive construct that's materialistic”. The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): a region of conditions reads as the boundary a center represents, and the conditions a formation actually takes part in and requires as its actual dependence. A center's boundary can cover what it requires and not what it takes part in, so it keeps itself and undermines another; or it can omit what it requires, so its own draw loses its own support; only a boundary covering what it takes part in gives renewal at the step. Nothing here models how a center forms or represents a boundary, and the region has no status outside the unfolding. This prepares a comparison for route (b) (P40), on which “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on; that route has not begun. The reading and the names are the AI's.

## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T221720.428753Z): the 46 theorems of Becoming.Admission and the 26 of Becoming.Regions all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 91 modules (including the import-only root and the four bridge modules) with 4983 theorems/7020 declaration audits, and 39 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 90 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §51 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

A region of conditions is a parameter of the statement, and nothing here models how a center forms or represents it; the comparison is at one step (dependence over several steps is given by P40's feeding closure and compared with a represented boundary in Overshoot; see feeding-closure and consumption-ends-with-feeders); Omitted and Clearing are minimal witnesses, their activity and requirements stipulated and shown consistent with balance, support and dependence; contains no ethical predicate, and says neither which boundary should be represented nor what a center should do; reading a region of conditions as a represented boundary is the AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation; the names (RenewingOver, Omitted and others) are the AI's wording, adopted under Ren's naming rule.

- Covering what is required does not prevent undermining another: the clearer renews over its resource at every step and undermines at step one (Clearing.renewing_over_resource). [Regions.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Regions.lean)
- Renewal over a region omitting a requirement does not keep its own support (Omitted.loses_own). [Regions.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Regions.lean)

<a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [becoming-stepwise-reading](becoming-stepwise-reading.md). Reuses the stepwise reading: Web.RenewingAt, Web.UnderminingAt, Web.RenewingAt.not_undermining and Web.MetAbove.now.
- **formal-reuse**: [derived-extent-limits](derived-extent-limits.md). Reuses Clearing.undermines_within_renewal: the clearer depends only on its resource, which is renewed, and its event at step one undermines the dweller.
- **formal-reuse**: [support-from-the-supported](support-from-the-supported.md). Reuses Web.Untightened: requirements that do not tighten across a step.

**Output:** An event within renewal is not undermining (Web.RenewingAt.not_undermining).

**Input:** Renewal over a region compared with renewal at the step; undermining where the region omits a required or drawn condition.

**Preserved conditions:** The stepwise reading's definitions; no valuation is used. [Dependence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dependence.lean)


**Output:** The clearer depends only on its resource, every dependence on which is kept at every step; it undermines at step one.

**Input:** The clearer renews over its resource at every step and is not within renewal at step one.

**Preserved conditions:** As in Clearing.undermines_within_renewal. [Continuation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Continuation.lean)


**Output:** Requirements that do not tighten across a step.

**Input:** Keeping its own support while renewing over a region covering what it requires.

**Preserved conditions:** None beyond the representation. [Admission.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Admission.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [loss-beyond-a-region](loss-beyond-a-region.md). Regions of formations there, regions of conditions here; both are parameters of the statement.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [conveyance-crosses-the-boundary](conveyance-crosses-the-boundary.md). There a continuing family's region is no cut in the relations; here a region a formation renews over can omit what it requires.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [feeding-closure](feeding-closure.md). The feeding closure gives dependence over several steps (the sources feeding what is required).
- Related, not a proved adapter: [consumption-ends-with-feeders](consumption-ends-with-feeders.md). In Overshoot a formation renewing over the condition it requires and keeping its own support still ends through its feeder.

**Used by:** [consumption-ends-with-feeders](consumption-ends-with-feeders.md) (application)
